condition:
recombinant WT KpEnc coexpressed with cognate 
full-length KpDyP cargo in E. coli BL21(DE3); DyP-loaded
notes:
Canonical cognate DyP-loaded WT T=1 KpEnc assembly. Jones, Andreas & Giessen 2024 directly reported a 24 nm 
icosahedral shell composed of 60 KpEnc subunits. PDB 8U50 / EMD-41905 represents the WT shell coexpressed with cognate full-length KpDyP cargo, with an average loading of ~12 DyP monomers per shell; most cargo remained flexible and was not resolved in the icosahedrally averaged shell model. PDB 8U51 / EMD-41906 represents the same WT T=1 shell loaded with heterologous SUMO fused to the native DyP targeting peptide to increase targeting-peptide occupancy and resolve the TP-shell interaction; this engineered cargo-loading condition is not treated as a distinct assembly because the global shell architecture is unchanged. PDB 8U4Z / EMD-41904 represents isolated KpDyP cargo and is not a shell assembly.
